claims.text: The FDA acitretin label states that a pharmacokinetic interaction with combined oral contraceptives, a formulation class that can include desogestrel, has not been established.
claims.quote: It has not been established if there is a pharmacokinetic interaction between acitretin and combined oral contraceptives.

headline.text: The FDA acitretin label says a pharmacokinetic interaction with combined oral contraceptives has not been established.

reported.text: This label statement concerns combined oral contraceptives as a class and does not provide a desogestrel-specific result.

gaps.text: The packet contains no desogestrel-specific study or formulation details establishing whether the separate microdosed progestin warning applies to this pair.
